entries.speaker: Begging for Life
entries.en: When an enemy is in a dire situation, it may try to[n]bargain for its life, enabling you to negotiate with it[n]and possibly gain a Persona.

entries.speaker: Begging for Life
entries.en: A Shadow's personality determines how likely it is[n]to beg. [clr 2]Timid[clr 27] Shadows are more likely to beg, while[n][clr 2]Irritable[clr 27] Shadows won't beg very often.
